records.title: Science Academies' Summer Research Fellowship Programme 2027
records.organization: Indian Academy of Sciences, INSA & NASI (Science Academies)
records.officialDescription: Two-month Summer Fellowships for students and teachers to work with an assigned guide. Selected fellows receive round-trip train fare and a monthly fellowship to meet their living expenses at the place of work. Student applicants upload scanned mark sheets from Class X till the last examination (JPEG, each not exceeding 700 kb) and the contact details of one of their present teachers.
records.summary: A two-month research stint with a scientist guide. For BE/BTech/BCA students, only II and III year students are eligible.
records.verificationNotes: Deadline, BE/BTech/BCA year rule, 65% rule and documents quoted from the application instructions page. Benefits quoted from the programme home page. Fellowship amount is not stated on these pages.
records.deadlineNote: "The last date for receipt of applications online is 30 November 2026."

stipend.description: Monthly fellowship to meet living expenses at the place of work, plus round-trip train fare. Amount not stated on the official pages.

records.title: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girl Students (Technical Degree) 2026-27
records.organization: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
records.officialDescription: Scheme implemented by AICTE to assist girls pursuing technical education. Rs. 50,000 per annum for every year of study (maximum 4 years for first-year admitted students and maximum 3 years for lateral-entry students), paid as a lump sum towards college fee, computer, stationery, books, equipment, software etc. Applications are made online on the National Scholarship Portal and verified by the host institution and the State/UT Department of Technical Education. Selection is on merit of the qualifying examination.
records.summary: ₹50,000 a year for girl students who joined an AICTE-approved degree course this year (or second year via lateral entry), with family income up to ₹8 lakh.
records.verificationNotes: Dates from the NSP All Scholarships listing for Academic Year 2026-27 (scheme open 01-06-2026, student application open till 31-10-2026). Eligibility and amount from the degree guideline PDF linked on NSP, which is titled 2020-21; NSP still links it for 2026-27.
records.deadlineNote: Student application deadline on NSP. Institute verification is open till 15-11-2026.

records.title: PM-USP Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship (CSSS) 2026-27 — Renewal
records.organization: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education
records.officialDescription: Financial assistance to meritorious students from poor families to meet part of their day-to-day expenses during higher studies, awarded on the basis of Class XII results. Rate: ₹12,000 per annum at graduation level for the first three years; B.Tech/B.Engg students get ₹12,000 p.a. for 1st–3rd year and ₹20,000 in the 4th year. Renewal each year requires at least 50% marks in the annual examination and at least 75% attendance. Students with gross parental/family income up to ₹4.5 lakh per annum are eligible.
records.summary: Renewal window for students who already hold the CSSS scholarship. NSP listed renewals (not fresh applications) for 2026-27 when Naviq checked.
records.verificationNotes: NSP lists this scheme with Renewal dates for AY 2026-27 (scheme open 01-06-2026, student application open till 31-10-2026). Rates and rules from the guideline PDF (applicable from 2022-23).
records.deadlineNote: Renewal application deadline on NSP. Institute verification is open till 15-11-2026.

award.description: ₹12,000 p.a. for 1st–3rd year; ₹20,000 in the 4th year for B.Tech/B.Engg.

records.title: Google Summer of Code (next edition)
records.officialDescription: A global, online program focused on bringing new contributors into open source software development, with 12+ week programming projects. Projects are scoped for ~90 hours (Small), ~175 hours (Medium), or ~350 hours (Large). Google provides a stipend for participants who pass their evaluations and are eligible to receive stipends.
